com.figma.Desktop.note: The endpoint isn't declared anywhere on disk. Figma rolls out in stages and this asks without one, which gets the last cohort's answer: it can lag, but never offers what Figma wouldn't. Never send localVersion; the server echoes it back. Each chip reads its own address; both checked 2026-09-08.

com.getdropbox.dropbox.note: Dropbox publishes no version anywhere except the name of the file its download link redirects to. Checked 2026-09-02.

com.github.wez.wezterm.note: Every WezTerm build reports 0.1.0, and the release tags are dates (20240203-110809-5046fc22), so no source can ever be compared. Checked 2026-09-01.

com.google.Chrome.exclude: Chrome updates itself through Google's updater (Keystone).

com.hegenberg.BetterTouchTool.note: The feed the app declares (appcast.xml) lags releases by weeks; appcast_manual.xml matches the released build. Checked 2026-09-01.

com.insomnia.app.note: The download address redirects to the release asset. HEAD answers 404; only GET redirects. Checked 2026-09-02.

com.jetbrains.pycharm.note: Same shape as IntelliJ IDEA: type=release pinned, compared on the version because the build (PY-262...) doesn't parse. Each chip reads its own address; both checked 2026-09-08.

com.logi.pluginservice.exclude: Part of Logi Options+, which updates it.

com.logseq.logseq.note: Same place the app's own updater reads (app-update.yml). A 'nightly' tag is flagged prerelease and skipped. Assets are per chip and picked automatically. Checked 2026-09-08.

com.lujjjh.LinearMouse.note: Betas are flagged prerelease, so latest is always stable. Download checked 2026-09-01.

com.lwouis.alt-tab-macos.note: Sparkle, but Info.plist carries no feed URL. No beta channel in the feed. Checked 2026-09-01.

com.openai.codex.note: The Codex-based ChatGPT, not the native one (com.openai.chat). The app carries no feed address. Compare on the short version (26.831.20005); the build counts separately. Each chip reads its own address; both checked 2026-09-08.

com.raycast.macos.note: Deliberately the 1.x line; a 2.x line lives on another host. Checked 2026-08-31.

com.utmapp.UTM.note: Betas are flagged prerelease. The App Store copy shares this bundle id but is always checked against the App Store. Checked 2026-09-01.

org.cryptomator.note: No updater in the app. Assets are per chip (arm64, x64) and picked automatically. Checked 2026-09-08.
